C1161.title: Uber Fined €290 Million for Cross-Border Data Transfer Violations
C1161.summary: Uber was fined €290 million by the Dutch Data Protection Authority for failing to implement adequate safeguards on personal data transferred from European Economic Area drivers to the United States for over 27 months, violating GDPR rules on cross-border data transfers. This case highlights compliance risks associated with cross-border transfer of employee data.
